full_graph_justification: Independently authenticated a5e2badae344ba4baa29dad865603db459455f77 bundle and used its frozen G4 brief/reference. Final graph reviewed, not author counts alone; coordinator confirmed this author and all broker calls final before transcript hashing.

Exactly six original blocks: input header, ferrite rail, TL431 reference, dual-opamp photodiode, ADS1115 and four-hole mounting. Every complete parameter object, port contract and instance requirement equals frozen reference after function-based identifier mapping. No NTC, RS485, MCU or new block.

All five physical bindings checked: raw header pin1 to ferrite pin1; ferrite pin2 feeds ADC pin8 and MCP6002 pin8 and reference resistor bank; TL431 pins1/2 feed photodiode divider and ADC pin6; TIA output pin7 reaches ADC pin5; common ground includes unused ADC AIN0 pin4 plus AIN3 pin7, ADDR pin1, supply returns and connector grounds.

Full expanded-intent comparison after bijective instance/net renaming equals reference in every field except order-dependent graph hash: exact28 component selections and footprints, all11 physical net partitions, BOM, all layout constraints, evidence/dependencies, mechanical envelope, fab/manufacturing contract and checks. Independently expanded final graph: no refusals, all42 checks PASS.

Reference load arithmetic:2.65/19800+10uA=143.838uA below500uA retained allowance. Worst reference feed(3.4-2.35)/330=3.181818mA; plus2mA TIA and3mA ADC=8.181818mA below10mA analog budget and150mA external source. Minimum cathode current with retained500uA scenario=1.131881mA. Budgets are manual fixed-design checks, not a generic runtime power-flow proof.

Preserves0–50uA imposed photocurrent,940nm/DC–1Hz acquisition,10k feedback/four22pF capacitors, buffered half-reference bias,100nF+10uF opamp bypass, driven BIAS guard and common-ground RETURN_PATH. Grounding unused ADC input does not join the optical output or reference to ground.

External host retains100kHz/50pF I2C, sequential single-shot8SPS, ±4.096V range, OS polling and score computation. ADC header pins1/2 ground,3/4/5 SDA/SCL/ALERT; no exported host supply or onboard firmware claim.

Modeled reference interval, aggregate50mV error, typical ADC loading and ideal loop stability remain engineering assumptions, not accuracy/radiometric guarantees. Layout intent including guard, return paths, compact pads and mounting is preserved but no routed copper, DRC, fabrication or hardware performance is established.
Attempt two final graph g4-independent-two; transcript has 13 preserved entries. Original submissions, query errors, author notes and packets unchanged.
